{{Quotation|game|[[The Frost Gate (landmark)|The Frost Gate]] was built by the [[Deldrimor]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] as a way to protect their homes from invaders coming through [[Borlis Pass]]. When civil war broke out, the gate fell into the hands of the [[Stone Summit]], a xenophobic group of Dwarven renegades who are trying to overthrow [[King Jalis Ironhammer]]. Now, no one gets through the pass unless the Summit allows it.}}

[[The Frost Gate (outpost)|The Frost Gate]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]] and is the last Deldrimor outpost on the way to a gigantic gate built to regulate passage between the western and eastern [[Shiverpeak Mountains|Shiverpeaks]]. The outpost is commanded by [[Brechnar Ironhammer]], brother to King Jalis Ironhammer.

==Getting There==

*From [[Ice Tooth Cave]] follow the road to the southeast.
*The mission [[Borlis Pass]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[The Frost Gate]]
**This mission is the sixth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the second and last mission in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] region.
